subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hooks to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix expands the public plugin API and sets reaction payload semantics that should not be chosen by automation alone.

options.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
options.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with tests and docs, and leave room for channel parity.

options.title: Scope Discord First
options.body: Accept a Discord-specific first step now, with explicit follow-up criteria so payload and names do not become permanent cross-channel drift.

options.title: Defer The API
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events and external workarounds until maintainers sponsor a broader non-message plugin event design.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Observation Hooks
recommendation.body: Add reaction_added and reaction_removed as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with tests and docs, and leave room for channel parity.

likelyOwner.reason: This changes the plugin hook contract, and vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on that surface.
